data.description:
## Context / Problem
About twenty single-turn LLM call sites build a `RunRequest` (`src/rebar/llm/runner.py:80-143`) and only two bound output tokens, one bounds retries and timeout: `overlap/judge.py:163` (`judge_one`, inherits the generic 16k/600s) vs `judge_batch:203` (bounded — bug `leathery-druidic-nurseshark`, now inverted), `workflow/runs.py:346`, `completion_recovery.py:307,404`, `plan_review/passes.py:286,388,469,520,582`, `xcheck.py:199,337`, `completion_subcall.py:193`, `prerequisites.py:231`, `fidelity_spot_eval.py:103,115` (no model-class binding), `enrich.py:183`, `epic_bug_screen.py:266`, `code_review/workflow_ops.py:604`. `structured_run.build_usage_limits:393-438` returns the bare limit while `completion_banking.iteration_limit_for:278-285` inverts it, so successor budgets can be off by the retry allowance (part of the `creatable-foldable-arthropods` / `earthen-flayed-baboon` / `binary-cobwebby-bittern` family). RP-01 owns provider retry semantics and is not changed.

## Approach
Add `RunRequest.for_structured(cfg, *, model_class, output_tokens, timeout_s, structured_retries=0, transport_attempts=1, iteration_limit=None)` in `structured_run.py` with keyword-only, required bounds (no inherit-by-omission), and make `build_usage_limits` return the allowance-inclusive value so `iteration_limit_for` cannot drift. Adopt at every single-turn site with each site's *current effective* values, so behaviour is unchanged. Guard: `RunRequest(` constructed directly outside `runner.py`/`structured_run.py` only at the agentic sites (`operations.py`, `spec_scan.py`, `interpreter.py`), listed explicitly in the test.

## Scope
`src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py`, `src/rebar/llm/runner.py`, `src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_banking.py`, the call sites listed above, `tests/unit/llm/test_run_request_builder.py` (new).

## Testing
Table test: every adopted site's request carries the same bounds as before the change (snapshot taken from the current tree). Edge: omitting a bound is a `TypeError` at construction. Pinning: `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py`, `tests/unit/test_overlap_judge.py`, `tests/unit/test_completion_budget.py`, `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_banking.py` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `judge_one` and `judge_batch` declare the same bound set; checked by the builder test.
- [ ] `iteration_limit_for(build_usage_limits(...))` round-trips to the same value on every budget in the fixture set; checked by a property test.
- [ ] Pinning suites pass unchanged; checked by `pytest`.
data.title: RunRequest.for_structured builder with required bounds for single-turn LLM calls
